items.title: Solana cuts mainnet slot time to 350 milliseconds in first step toward 200ms goal
items.whyYouShouldCare: Reducing mainnet slot time enhances Solana's transaction speed, potentially increasing network efficiency and attracting more developers and users to the ecosystem.

items.title: Regulation Crypto is here: State of Crypto
